svg.title: StreamDecisionBench — in-force accuracy across update intervals
svg.desc: 17 single-model settings, 8 cloud APIs and 9 self-hosted open-weight settings. Normalized log-AUC over update intervals of 0.5–8 seconds; one pass per hosted setting and means of three passes per self-hosted setting.
svg.text: The curves beneath the leaderboard score · Logarithmic interval weighting from 0.5 to 8 s
